node.statement: Internal Stinespring rectangle and correction ledger: the iterative GNS/Stinespring construction for UCP T gives Hilbert spaces K_j, isometries V_j:K_{j-1}->K_j, and contractive unital star-homomorphisms u_j:B(K_{j-1})->B(K_j), with the one-step compression identity u_j(V_j^*UV_j)=V_{j+1}^*u_{j+1}(U)V_{j+1} for U in B(K_j), and its iterates. All four source memberships are therefore U in B(K_j), never U in K_j. For R_k(X)=u_{2+k,1}((I_1-V_1V_1^*)u_1(T(X)))V_{2+k}V_{1+k}, exact multiplication and the iterated compression identity give R_k(X)^*R_k(X)=u_{k,0}(G_X), hence ||R_k(X)||<=sqrt(3eta)||X||. The auxiliary identity has final factor V_{1+k}: V_{1+k}^*V_{2+k}^*u_{2+k,1}(Z)V_{2+k}V_{1+k}=V_{1+k}^*u_{1+k,0}(V_1^*ZV_1)V_{1+k}; using V_1 there is ill-typed. With A=T(X), B=T(Y), C=T(Z), A1=T^2(X), B1=T^2(Y), C1=T^2(Z), the operator W=V_1^*R_1(X^*)^*u_{3,0}(T(Y))V_3R_0(Z) obeys ||W||<=3eta||X||||Y||||Z||, and expanding both I_1-V_1V_1^* factors then compressing gives exactly W=T(Q), Q=T(T(AB)C)-T^2(AB)C1-T(A1B1C)+T(A1B1)C1.
